item.title: AutoFish
item.description: AutoFish is a Fishing mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io by xiaoye97. Fully automatic fishing — auto-cast, auto-hook and auto-reel. Idle-friendly; works while you alt-tab. Does not work with the legacy fishing mini-game setting. What it does Auto-cast, auto-hook and auto-reel with zero input after start Stops automatically when you interact, so it never fights your play Does NOT work with the legacy fishing mini-game setting — check your options Best idle setup: stand surrounded by water on all four sides How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.

item.title: Core Keeper Fishing FAQ — Water Types, Rare Fish, Bait
Core Keeper Fishing Filter — Every Fish by Water Type & Catch Chance
item.description: Every fish in Core Keeper, filterable by water type and sortable by catch chance. This fishing filter combines the full fish compendium with interactive controls — tick the biomes you’re fishing in, search for a specific fish, and sort to plan your collection or your next cooking run. Browse every fish by water type — tick the biomes you fish in, search by name, and sort by catch chance to plan your collection.

item.title: Core Keeper Fishing Guide — Best Spots, Bait, the Fishing Workbench and Rare Fish
item.description: Fishing in Core Keeper is more than a side activity: it is a second ore income, a key source of accessories, and the only way to summon Omoroth later. This advanced Core Keeper fishing guide explains how the catch system decides what you pull out, how to set up a fishing corner, and which water to stand in for the rare fish and valuables you actually want. item.title: Master Fishing
item.description: Master Fishing is a Fishing mod for Core Keeper available on Steam Workshop. Fully automated fishing with bonus XP and doubled catch results. What it does Fully automated fishing on Steam Workshop Bonus XP and doubled catch output Handy for achievement hunting How to install Open the Steam Workshop page for this mod and click Subscribe — the game installs it automatically on next launch. Safety & compatibility Version check first: mods list their compatible game version on their page.

item.title: MikuFish
item.description: MikuFish is a Fishing mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io by barroit. item.title: Treasure Net
item.description: Treasure Net is a Fishing mod for Core Keeper available on Steam Workshop. Fishing nets can haul in treasure as well as fish — enable treasure mode for mod-exclusive bonus items. What it does Fishing nets haul treasure as well as fish Enable treasure mode for mod-exclusive bonus items Configurable per resource type (fish/kelp/loot/treasure) How to install Open the Steam Workshop page for this mod and click Subscribe — the game installs it automatically on next launch.
